=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-537 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The emitted parenthetical summary unconditionally includes Semble-specific counters, changing the legacy non-Semble format.
  WHY: Several reviewers call this a byte-for-byte compatibility regression for non-Semble consumers; some also note it was pre-existing/out-of-scope, but the highest severity reported is high.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:431-493 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Semble query/binary/index validation is repeated for every overflowing file instead of being hoisted once.
  WHY: This creates redundant I/O/syscalls per overflowed target; reviewers disagree on importance, with some calling it a pre-existing micro-optimization and others a medium-priority efficiency issue.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-341 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose script reads the NUL-separated untracked list as text before regex extraction, which can garble path parsing.
  WHY: Reviewers report malformed or partial untracked paths in the Semble query; other reviewers invalidate this as a false positive, so there is direct reviewer disagreement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-341 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: NUL-separated path garbling in `extract_post_codex_semble_query`.
  WHY: FALSE POSITIVE — `UNTRACKED_CONTEXT_FILE` is built from the NUL-separated list into human-readable text before Python reads it, so the regex does not consume raw NUL-separated data.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-537 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Summary format always includes `chunk-retrieved-via-Semble`.
  WHY: Confirmed as pre-existing and out of scope for the last run; the last run did not modify this code.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:460-469 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Repeated Semble resolution in the overflow loop.
  WHY: Pre-existing micro-optimization; the last run did not worsen it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-523 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The summary line format unconditionally includes Semble-specific fields (`chunk-retrieved-via-Semble`, `marker-only`), changing the legacy output format when Semble is not configured.
  WHY: When Semble is not configured or not used, the output now shows `0 chunk-retrieved-via-Semble, X marker-only` instead of the original format, breaking backward compatibility for consumers relying on the prior contract.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:460-469 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: For each overflowing file, `_retrieve_semble_overflow` repeatedly performs query-file reading, binary-path resolution, and index-directory validation.
  WHY: This creates N× redundant I/O and syscall overhead when many files overflow the byte budget, so the work could be hoisted out of the loop.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-341 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script writes untracked files with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z` but then reads the file as text and processes it with regex.
  WHY: NUL separators get corrupted during text handling, leading to malformed or incomplete path extraction for the Semble query.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-525 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The summary format unconditionally includes Semble-specific counters even when Semble is not configured or used.
  WHY: When `chunk_retrieved = 0`, the output still contains `0 chunk-retrieved-via-Semble`, changing the legacy summary format that callers may parse or depend on.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:291-295, 304-320 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_retrieve_semble_overflow` repeats query-file reading, binary resolution, and index validation on every call.
  WHY: When multiple files overflow the budget, this causes redundant disk I/O, PATH lookups, and directory stat calls, scaling poorly with many overflow files.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:294-295, 335 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The untracked file list is written with NUL separators but read as text and processed with regex.
  WHY: Paths with spaces, newlines, or special characters can be concatenated without proper separators, causing malformed or incomplete untracked paths in the Semble query.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-537 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The parenthesized summary breakdown always includes `chunk-retrieved-via-Semble`, even when Semble is not configured and `chunk_retrieved` is 0.
  WHY: This changes the summary string structure for non-Semble consumers and violates the byte-for-byte preservation requirement for existing behavior.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-341 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pass-1 finding about NUL-separated untracked list handling is invalidated.
  WHY: The regex lookbehind excludes the relevant characters, so the function still extracts paths correctly from NUL-separated input and this is not an issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:521-537 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Summary construction always emits Semble-specific counters regardless of Semble configuration or usage.
  WHY: This changes the legacy summary format for non-Semble runs by adding an unused `chunk-retrieved-via-Semble=0` field.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:431-493 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_retrieve_semble_overflow` is invoked per overflowing file and repeats query-file reads, binary resolution, and index validation.
  WHY: This scales poorly with many overflowing targets because the same invariant checks are redone for every file.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-341 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `untracked = read_text(untracked_path)` is followed by regex extraction even though the source file is NUL-separated.
  WHY: That can garble the Semble query by merging path fragments into invalid or irrelevant matches.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===

  PROBLEM: The summary line format unconditionally includes `chunk-retrieved-via-Semble` counts even when Semble is not configured.
  WHY: When `--semble-index ""` is passed, the summary still shows `0 chunk-retrieved-via-Semble, N marker-only` instead of the legacy `N marker-only` format.

  PROBLEM: The cross-pollination finding about NUL-separated untracked list handling is invalidated.
